title: claude-settings guard: an agent never resets the lane's own branch
why: A round-1 designer agent in lane duo-gaps-design-review (PR 237) ran `git checkout -B`, which moved the lane's branch under the lane's checkout and left stale staged files. Restored; nothing lost.
note: Feedback for claude-settings, which the owner carries (sessions never edit claude-settings). Proposed guard: refuse an agent's `checkout -B` or `branch -f` on the lane's own branch. Reported by lane duo-gaps-design-review via the coordinator, 2026-11-08 20:14 CST.
